OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_DURATION_PERIOD.description: The period of time to await between two runs of the connector (ISO-8601 duration format).

CONNECTOR_UPDATE_EXISTING_DATA.description: Whether to update data already ingested into the platform.

TI_API_URL.description: Base URL of the Group-IB Threat Intelligence API.

TI_API_USERNAME.description: Username used to authenticate against the Group-IB TI API.

TI_API_TOKEN.description: API token used to authenticate against the Group-IB TI API.

TI_API_PROXY_IP.description: Optional proxy ip used to reach the Group-IB TI API.

TI_API_PROXY_PORT.description: Optional proxy port used to reach the Group-IB TI API.

TI_API_PROXY_PROTOCOL.description: Optional proxy protocol used to reach the Group-IB TI API.

TI_API_PROXY_USERNAME.description: Optional proxy username used to reach the Group-IB TI API.

TI_API_PROXY_PASSWORD.description: Optional proxy password used to reach the Group-IB TI API.
